summary:
S-63 and EQ-24 are answered by a new tray, r2. It is built from QRP Labs' own dimensions and released as a new set, `v2/release/case-2026-09-27/lid-tray-qmx-r2/`, beside the r1 tray. The release README (a dated addendum) and the MANIFEST now mark r1 and sheet 14 superseded. Every r1 file keeps its bytes, and `sha256sum -c` passes on all 59 files.

**What the maker states** (filed in `v2/vendor/qrp-labs/`):
- The enclosure is 95 x 63 x 25 mm without protrusions and weighs 220 g (product page of 24 Sep 2026; assembly manual 1.04r page 2).
- The end panels, knobs and rubber feet come from the assembly manual. The feet are optional and are not fitted in the tray.
- The maker gives no jack positions. I scaled them from the operating manual's panel and top-face figures, which match 63 x 25 to within 0.4 percent (`measure_qmx_figures.py`, `qmx-figures.out`). I cross-checked the right panel on the maker's photograph: the RF jack reads 12.1 mm from the knob edge on the figure and 8.3 mm on the photo. The tray allows for both readings plus 0.5 mm.

**The r2 design** (`v2/cad/lid_tray_qmx_r2.py`):
- Both end panels are open over their whole height above a 1.5 mm sill.
- The unit sits top face out, knob edge west, right panel (RF, PTT, USB) toward the hinge. With the lid open, the LCD and knobs face the operator; the VOL knob switches the radio on and off.
- Two ledges hold the unit. The knob-edge ledge is in three segments clear of both knobs and their finger room. A lintel ties each open end, gussets stiffen the walls, an end block sits at the hinge end and a screwed keeper at the front. Two PORON 4701-30 pads press the unit up against the ledges.
- Printed in Prusament PC Blend (heat deflection 113 C). The r1 PETG deflects at 68 C, below E3-S's +71 C storage.
- Ten flush M3 x 5 screws go into a 2.0 mm 5052 aluminium lid plate bonded to the lid with DP8005; no hole in the case.
- The east edge stays at X 171.0, so M19 is unchanged. The tray grows west to X 83.4 onto free lid ceiling.

**Build and checks**:
- Built on the box in a venv matching `requirements-cad.lock` line for line: STEP and STL, the plate STEP and DXF, sheets 14r2-1 and 14r2-2, and a check record. Both sheets were rendered and read back as images.
- The check builds the solids and confirms that the unit, every jack's largest allowed plug at all four corners of its place range, and both knobs with finger room touch neither part. Two control cases that must collide do collide.
- A rebuild gave identical STL files and check record.
- The r2 tests (8) plus the case geometry and frame_seat tests: 22 pass. The requirements tests: 69 pass, 1 skipped.

**Drafts in `drafts/w5tray/`** (applied by the integrator; tested on scratch copies):
- `apply_w5tray.py` takes the next free ids (SC-64, S-81, S-82, EQ-31 on the current tree) and does four things:
  - Records the choice as SC-TR-01, moves S-63 to closed, adds the two new open items and a registry header paragraph.
  - Rebinds four readings to the edited documents: CFL-015, CON-006, REQ-019 and FEA-007. It asserts the sections those readings cite are byte-identical.
  - Updates ASSEMBLY.md: the QMX row, build steps 10 and 11, the three lead rows, the removal paragraph and the parts list.
  - Updates the rest: CASE-FIT-UNCERTAINTIES, CASE-MARGINS, ENGINEERING-QUESTIONS, v2/README.md, v2/BUILD.md, START-HERE, the vendor README and SOURCES.yaml.
  
  The registry validator's output on a scratch copy is identical with and without this draft.
- `apply_frame_seat_r2.py` makes `frame_seat.py` read the r2 stack. M3 becomes +16.62 nominal and stays OPEN; no row is added, so the "70 rows, 35 OPEN" counts elsewhere do not move. It also updates the drift fixture in `test_frame_seat_inputs.py` to copy the r2 module.

**What stays open**, with S-63 itself closed:
- **The lid harness has no designed way through the sealed face plate** (new item S-81, EQ-31). Nothing in the tree designs where the three QMX leads get from the lid to boards A and B.
- **Retention is not proven** (new item S-82). By calculation the tray holds to 703 g on the makers' typical material figures. No held document states the peak E1's 1.22 m drop puts on the lid; a half-sine estimate gives 96 to 958 g, so the bound includes failure. The DP8005 bond on Peli's polypropylene has no strength figure either. No board, interface or purchase depends on this: the fix would be the same geometry machined in 6061 or a larger bonded plate.
- **The knob height is inferred, not stated.** 11.6 mm is scaled from a photo of the sibling QCX-mini. The knob tips clear the face with 1.21 mm at the worst case with unstated allowances doubled; that fails if the knob is taller than 11.81 mm. The chalk check T9 settles it.
- **The harness picks** must fit each jack's allowed plug size and the lanes' R 20 bend radius (R 12.5 for RG-316).

readings: BEFORE: S-63 OPEN and EQ-24 open. The r1 tray was notched at one end only; its 95 x 63 x 25 had no maker source; it was held by one hook-and-loop strap under a floor lying on the lid; PETG (68 C heat deflection); its fixing named PEM nuts in a 2 mm ABS plate. frame_seat M3 read +19.92 / +16.39 / +18.25 / +14.11, OPEN, for a 28.0 tray that counted no plate. M19 read +2.08 / +1.70, MET.

AFTER, maker figures: 95 x 63 x 25 mm and 220 g (qrp-labs.com product page and assembly manual 1.04r page 2). The panel figures scale to 63 x 25 within 0.4 percent (left 2.511 aspect, right 2.524, against 2.520). Jacks, measured from the knob edge and from the unit's bottom face: DC 10.7 / 11.9; Audio 20.9 / 8.5; Paddle 32.8 / 8.5; RF 12.1 / 11.6 on the figure and 8.3 / 10.5 on the photograph; PTT 29.7 / 8.5 (figure) and 29.0 / 7.9 (photo); USB 41.1 / 7.0 (figure) and 41.1 / 6.8 (photo). Both knobs are 21.4 from their end faces and 13.7 from the knob edge. The LCD window is 15.5 to 79.5 along the length and 16.3 to 30.5 from the back edge. The same figures come out byte for byte in the pinned venv.

AFTER, largest plug each jack admits at the worst of its place: DC 18.8, Audio 12.0, Paddle 12.0, RF 16.0, PTT 10.8, USB-C 8.6 high. Boolean checks on the built solids: no intersection for the unit, 24 plug bodies, 4 USB overmolds or 2 knob zones. Controls (the unit 1.0 higher, the RF plug 1.0 fatter) intersect at 433.2 and 4.241 mm3. Lead room: the right panel is 58.43 from the ceiling's flat edge, so a BNC plug may be up to 42.9 long (RG-316 at R 12.5) and a USB plug up to 35.4 (R 20). The left panel is 78.43 away, so a DC plug may be up to 55.4 long with an R 20 loop.

AFTER, face room with the lid closed (nominal / worst / worst with unstated allowances doubled): under the walls and ledges (M3r2a) 16.62 / 13.09 / 10.81, MET. Over the buttons under the unit's top face (M3r2b) 18.62 / 15.09 / 12.81, OPEN on the button cap heights; MET for caps up to 11.81. Knob tips (M3r2k) 7.02 / 3.49 / 1.21, MET on the inferred 11.6 knob and OPEN on its unstated height; MET for knobs up to 11.81. M19 unchanged at +2.08 / +1.70, MET. The stack from the lid ceiling is 29.30 to the unit's top face and 31.30 to the tray's open face.
AFTER, pads: PORON 4701-30, 3.18 mm, 34 percent compression nominal, 13 to 51 percent over the tolerance corners. At 25 percent the sheet gives 20 to 53 N over 960 mm2.

AFTER, retention on the makers' typical figures, less their stated spread: back ledge 1730 g; knob-edge ledge 756 g; walls out of the pocket 2237 and 2382 g; M3 threads in the plate 1682 g (5052 shear strength inferred); screw-head pull-through 2781 g; panel bearing on the sill 1768 g; keeper screws 854 g; a wall pushed sideways 703 g, which governs. The bond's crude peel-strength estimate is 182 g; it is not a bound. The half-sine estimate for the 1.22 m drop (E1) gives 958, 383, 192 and 96 g at 2, 5, 10 and 20 mm of stopping distance. The known links hold where the stopping distance is at least 2.7 mm, so the bound includes failure.
AFTER, masses: tray 49.0 g and keeper 1.3 g in PC Blend; lid plate 52.0 g in 5052. The tray is 111.6 x 87.6 x 29.1 mm at case X 83.4 to 171.0, Y -45.8 to 65.8.

AFTER, tests on the worktree: test_lid_tray_qmx_r2 8 of 8, and with case_geometry and frame_seat 22 passed and 0 failed. The requirements tests give 69 passed and 1 skipped. rules_lib.py requirements on the branch: 144 records, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The case release manifest passes sha256sum -c on all 59 files. A rebuild gave identical STL and check record.
decisions: SESSION choice, taken under the owner's standing rule of 26 Sep 2026 (drafted SC-TR-01) and not the owner's: r2 is open across both end panels above a 1.5 mm sill. Reason: the maker gives no jack positions, and the figure and photograph disagree by up to 3.8 mm. Reverse with a maker's dimensioned panel drawing that shows an end wall can clear every plug.

SESSION: the unit sits top face out, knob edge west, right panel toward the hinge. Reason: the LCD and knobs face the operator with the lid open, the VOL knob is the power switch, and RF and USB leave straight toward the hinge harness while the knobs stay clear of the button column. Reverse if a lead route needs the other end at the hinge.

SESSION: the unit is held by structure, not a strap: ledges (the knob-edge one segmented clear of the knobs with 6 mm finger room), end lintels, gussets, an integral end block, a screwed keeper, and PORON 4701-30 preload pads. Reason: r1's strap passed under a floor that lies on the lid, which cannot work, and E1 and E2 need a positive load path. Reverse if E1 or E2 show a lighter retention holds.

SESSION: the material is Prusament PC Blend instead of PETG. Reason: PETG deflects at 68 C against E3-S's +71 C storage; PC Blend deflects at 113 C and has a stated interlayer strength of 21 MPa. Reverse with a material whose maker states a heat deflection above 71 C and interlayer strength at least as high.

SESSION: the tray is fixed to a 2.0 mm 5052-H32 lid plate, tapped through, bonded with DP8005, using ten flush M3 x 5 countersunk screws whose tips stop 0.6 mm short of the bond. Reason: no hole may go in the case (ruling of 7 Sep 2026), and PEM clinch nuts in an ABS plate cannot work. Reverse with a bonded fixing whose maker states its strength on polypropylene.

SESSION: place. The east edge stays at X 171.0 (C5, M19 unchanged) and the tray grows west to X 83.4 for the gussets; Y centre 10.0 as r1. panel1450.QMX_TRAY_X is not edited, so r1's tests and sheet still hold. Reverse if a lid item needs X 83.4 to 102.0.

SESSION: released files are left untouched. r2 is a new folder; the release README gets a dated addendum and the MANIFEST keeps its original header, adds a SUPERSEDED comment line and the new digests. Every original digest was asserted against git HEAD.

SESSION: the knob-tip room stays in the r2 record (M3r2k) rather than becoming a new frame_seat row, so the '70 rows, 35 OPEN' counts in the product brief, FEA-007 and the case pages do not move. The frame_seat draft only corrects M3 to the r2 stack.

SESSION: the lid harness's crossing of the sealed face was found undesigned and is recorded as open item S-81 and engineering question EQ-31. The recommended answer is a sealed panel-mount connector set in the plate's top strip. I did not choose it, because it changes a released CNC part and belongs to the case writer.

SESSION: retention verification stays OPEN as S-82 rather than being closed on an assumed peak (no convenient value inserted). The half-sine bound includes failure, but no board, interface or purchase depends on it.
open_items: S-81 / EQ-31 (new, design work, layer 7). Engineering question: where and how do the QMX's DC lead, USB-C lead and RG-316 jumper get from the lid to board B's J_QMX and board A's J_HF and J_RF2 under C1's face plate? The plate covers the frame window and Peli's o-ring and has no pass-through. The crossing must meet REQ-021 and CON-008, fit the top strip, and work with the lid's swing. Options: (a) a sealed panel-mount connector set in the plate's top strip near the hinge (recommended); (b) a sealed gland. It needs a new face-plate version and case release.

S-82 (1), the bond. What is the DP8005 bond strength between the 5052 lid plate and the Peli 1450 lid's polypropylene? The held 3M sheet gives only a T-peel on 0.5 mm HDPE, so no bound exists. Check: a pull test with CASE-MARGINS T8. Remedy if weak: a larger plate or a surface treatment; no board moves.

S-82 (2), the E1 peak. What peak does E1's 26 drops from 1.22 m put on the lid? MIL-STD-810H 516.8 sets the drop, not a pulse. By calculation the known links hold to 703 g (a wall pushed sideways). The half-sine estimate of 96 to 958 g includes failure. Check: E1 with an accelerometer on the lid. Remedy: the same STEP machined in 6061, or a larger plate; no interface changes.

S-82 (3), the knob height. QRP Labs states no knob height; 11.6 mm is scaled from a photo of the sibling QCX-mini. The tips keep 1.21 mm at the worst case with unstated allowances doubled; that fails above 11.81 mm (14.09 mm at the plain worst). Check: T9 with chalk on the knob tips, or the unit in hand. Remedy: a lower-profile knob, or a ring-shaped lid plate that lowers the unit by about 2.2 mm (costed at desk only).

S-82 (4), the harness picks. The RG-316 BNC plug, the USB-C lead and the 2.1 x 5.5 plug lead are not picked. Each must fit its jack's largest allowed plug: BNC diameter 16.0 and 42.9 long; USB-C 8.6 high and 35.4 long; DC diameter 18.8 and 55.4 long. The DC and USB leads must bend at R 20 or less and RG-316 at R 12.5 or more. A threadlocker for the plate threads that its maker states is compatible with PC is also TBD.

Integrator: apply drafts/w5tray/apply_w5tray.py, then apply_frame_seat_r2.py. After that: re-read CASE-MARGINS.md's M3 row and text (it becomes +16.62 / +13.09 / +14.95 / +10.81), rebind whatever reads frame_seat.out, re-render REQUIREMENTS-TRACE.md, and write the LAYER-STATUS layer 7 integrator line (remaining item (2) answered; S-81, S-82 and EQ-31 replace it). The registry change comes after layer 3's reviewed file, so the layer 3 re-baseline (S-80, S-51, S-78) must read it; the header paragraph states the difference.

Carried, not new: the C&K ATP19/ATP16 cap heights under the unit's top face (M3, T9; MET for caps up to 11.81). E2's vibration levels are not held (MIL-STD-810H 514.8 not filed); the pads' preload and E2's pass line are the check. v2/cad/render/scene.py still draws the r1 tray, and that render is already marked superseded for measurement.
commit_subject: feat(case): the QMX lid tray r2 from the maker's dimensions, open at both end panels, with its keeper, lid plate, record and sheets 14r2-1 and 14r2-2 [MESHSAT-1357]
commit_body:
S-63 and ENGINEERING-QUESTIONS EQ-24, pre-PCB layer 7. Prototype design: nothing made, printed or fitted.

The r1 tray of 9 September 2026 was notched at one end, while the QMX has jacks on both end panels, and its 95 x 63 x 25 had no maker source. The r2 set is added beside it as v2/release/case-2026-09-27/lid-tray-qmx-r2/. The release's own files keep their bytes. The release README gains a dated addendum marking lid-tray-qmx/ and sheet 14 superseded, and MANIFEST.sha256 keeps its header, adds a SUPERSEDED comment line and the new digests.

Maker documents filed in v2/vendor/qrp-labs/: the product page text (95 x 63 x 25 without protrusions, 220 g), a page subset of assembly manual 1.04r (enclosure parts, optional feet, 15 mm knobs), the right-panel product photograph, and the operating manual's three figures extracted pixel for pixel. measure_qmx_figures.py scales the figures to the maker's 63 x 25 (within 0.4 percent) and cross-checks the photograph (qmx-figures.out). Prusament PC Blend and PETG data sheets are filed in v2/vendor/materials/.

v2/cad/lid_tray_qmx_r2.py builds the tray, its keeper and a 2.0 mm 5052 lid plate. Both end panels are open above a 1.5 mm sill. The unit sits top face out, knob edge west, right panel toward the hinge, held by ledges clear of the knobs, end lintels, gussets, an end block and a keeper, pressed to the ledges by PORON 4701-30 pads. The tray is PC Blend; ten flush M3 x 5 screws go into the plate, which is bonded with DP8005. The east edge stays at X 171.0 (M19 unchanged).

lid_tray_qmx_r2_check.py records each jack's largest admitted plug, the leads' bend room, the face room (M3r2a, M3r2b, M3r2k), the pads, and each retention link against E1's drop bound. With --solids it runs boolean checks with two controls that must intersect. lid_tray_qmx_r2_drawing.py draws sheets 14r2-1 and 14r2-2. build_lid_tray_r2.sh builds the set; it ran on the CAD box in a venv matching requirements-cad.lock, and both sheets were read back as images.

test_lid_tray_qmx_r2.py checks the jack table against qmx-figures.out, open ends, ledge clearances, the east edge, face room at the worst, pad contact, screw tips and the release manifest, each against a defective copy.

Still open: the retention (bond strength on polypropylene, E1's peak on the lid, the knob height, the harness picks) and the lid harness's crossing of the sealed face, which nothing designs. The registry, EQ and document changes and the frame_seat.py change are drafts in drafts/w5tray/.

Session choices under the owner's standing rule of 26 September 2026, recorded with reasons and reversals in the r2 README; nothing here is the owner's.
